qualification: UNRUN hosted receiving design and source review; no native receiving was executed or written by this lane.

fence.native_capacity: No new native writes or alternate-mount testing.

source_contract: One captured selection view supplies selected function/report/prompt source, then one materialized execution template supplies separately disposable baseline, generation and repair sandboxes. The live caller root remains a separate path/module reservation source.

baseline_cli.cases: False pass after live 2-to-7 edit; inverse false failure; unchanged healthy control. Emitted patches actually applied and ran against captured source.

retained_evidence.readonly_attempts: Both original and first-candidate fixture creation failed at destination.mkdir with ENOSPC before any product code. Neither a product pass nor a product failure is inferred.

static_findings.name: Read-only private link parent
static_findings.assessment: Material first-candidate risk independently confirmed in source; behavioral outcome remains unrun.
static_findings.mechanism: copytree(symlinks=True) restores source directory modes before rebind unlinks and recreates captured links. An unprivileged process cannot rewrite entries in mode 0555 directories.

static_findings.name: Private-write amendment
static_findings.assessment: Structurally suitable for hosted qualification; no runtime acceptance.
static_findings.mechanism: Only non-link directories resolving inside the private selection view gain owner write/execute during construction; finally restores exact prior mode. Parent creation, ignored-target copying, and link rewrites are covered. Caller directories are never adjusted.

static_findings.name: Current main composition
static_findings.assessment: Current main loop remains the original baseline source. Current CLI rejects malformed complete-hunk input before client construction, and is preserved wholesale.

finite_independent_cases.expect: Actual original current-main TestPilot loop selects the alias once, runs baseline and generated test successfully, preserves caller bytes/link/modes and uses distinct phase directories.
Actual current capture-aware loop with the exact frozen first helper raises PermissionError through rebind before model/pytest work; caller bytes/link/modes remain exact.
Same read-only input succeeds with exact initial source in both actual pytest phases and caller identity preserved.
Mode-0555 project root and internal alias to ignored .venv source are captured and materialized with source bytes, alias selection/dedup and original root/locked modes preserved.
Private selection construction restores directory modes; every observed explicit Path.chmod addresses a non-link path inside the owned view.
Injected owned-view symlink recreation failure propagates after exact mode restoration; no caller mode change.
A caller test created after capture remains byte exact; generated tests get a new path and patch, and execute against captured source.
A caller test of the same import name added under another directory remains byte exact and forces a fresh generated module name.

The byte-identical authored CLI driver runs on the corrected current composition; misleading-success now fails with rc1 and patch pytest1, initial-source and unchanged controls pass with rc0 and patch pytest0. All source-consistency/caller-preservation oracles are true; exact source pins and actual Git HEAD match the checkout.

baseline_controls.method: Load the exact frozen control modules under testpilot-qualified names against the current unchanged dependencies. Never overwrite the checkout's CLI, diff parser or source.

hosted_gate.required: Nine independent pytest cases actually pass under an unprivileged POSIX account, including the driver's three named actual CLI cases. No permission-case skips count as qualification. Preserve exact source identity and CI result.
hosted_gate.remaining: Run the authored corrected 16-case source suite and all nine independent cases through current-composition CI. Historical cec receipts and first-candidate 15-pass results remain historical.

limits: Initial filesystem capture is a finite copy window, not an atomic filesystem transaction.
Prepared interpreters, external services and dependencies outside the captured project are not generally frozen.
Source review and AST parsing are not execution.
Hosted POSIX permission receiving does not qualify Windows ACL semantics.
No provider requests, installed service changes, native writes, alternate-mount execution or permission exceptions are authorized by this receiving design.

previous_unrun_design.reason: Preserved eight-case design; this pre-execution amendment adds automatic collection of the unchanged actual CLI driver through one additional pytest case.
